top_stories.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published a blog post outlining its approach to safety and alignment as AI models increasingly operate over long time horizons and take extended sequences of actions. The post addresses new challenges posed by agentic AI systems, including how to maintain human oversight and prevent misaligned behaviour in models that plan and execute tasks autonomously. It signals a significant shift in how OpenAI is framing its safety research priorities.

top_stories.title: China's AI models have Trump's AI world at war with itself
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review reports on how the rise of competitive Chinese AI models is creating internal divisions within US AI policy circles, with open-weight Chinese models challenging American assumptions about export controls and proprietary AI dominance. The piece examines how models from companies like Moonshot AI and Alibaba are fuelling debate about whether restricting AI exports is helping or harming US strategic interests. The tension is reshaping the broader geopolitical framing of AI competition.

top_stories.title: China delivers a one-two punch to America's AI dominance
top_stories.summary: The Verge reports on the rapid release of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 and Alibaba's Qwen models, framing them as a coordinated challenge to US AI leadership via open-source strategy. The article notes that the open-weights approach allows global adoption without export control restrictions, giving Chinese models significant reach. Analysts quoted suggest this approach is proving more strategically effective than anticipated.

top_stories.title: AI is more likely than humans to form biases when hiring
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review covers new research finding that AI systems used in hiring decisions are more prone to forming and applying biases than human decision-makers in equivalent scenarios. The study raises concerns about the deployment of AI tools in recruitment workflows, particularly as adoption accelerates across large enterprises. The findings add weight to calls for stronger regulatory oversight of AI in high-stakes decision-making.

top_stories.title: How we measured AI writing across arXiv, and where the measurement breaks
top_stories.summary: Unslop.run publishes a detailed methodological account of measuring AI-generated writing across arXiv preprints, highlighting both what their approach captured and where it fell short. The post is notable for its transparency about detection limitations and the challenges of distinguishing AI-assisted from AI-generated text at scale. The findings have direct implications for academic publishing integrity and research quality assessment.

further_links.title: Import AI 465: Open vs closed gaps; Kimi K3; Demis' big policy plan
further_links.summary: Jack Clark's Import AI newsletter covers the widening gap between open and closed AI models, the release of Kimi K3, and DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis's emerging policy agenda.

further_links.title: UK 'should lean into research quality' on AI, says Elsevier leader
further_links.summary: The head of Elsevier argues the UK should prioritise research quality as a differentiator in the global AI race, with implications for how academic publishing intersects with AI development.

further_links.title: A Scene from the AI Flooding of Academic Journals
further_links.summary: A reported account of AI-generated content proliferating in academic journals, illustrating the scale and nature of the problem facing scholarly publishing.

further_links.title: Microsoft expands Azure AI and HPC infrastructure with AMD
further_links.summary: Microsoft announces an expansion of its Azure AI and high-performance computing infrastructure in partnership with AMD, signalling continued investment in AI compute capacity.

further_links.title: Here are the 30,000 songs Sony is suing Udio's AI music generator over
further_links.summary: Sony has identified 30,000 songs at the centre of its copyright lawsuit against AI music generator Udio, in one of the largest such legal actions in the generative AI space.

further_links.title: AI synthetic audience matches human polling in study
further_links.summary: A new study finds that AI-generated synthetic audiences can replicate the results of human polling with notable accuracy, raising questions for market and consumer research methodologies.

further_links.title: China's open-weights AI strategy is winning
further_links.summary: A commentary piece arguing that China's strategy of releasing open-weight AI models is outmanoeuvring the US approach of proprietary, locked-down systems in terms of global adoption and influence.

further_links.title: The Download: AI hiring biases, and weather data sabotage
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review's daily briefing covers the findings on AI hiring bias alongside a separate story on deliberate sabotage of weather data infrastructure. [Metered]
